---
name: Bug report
about: Reproducible incorrect behavior or regression
---

## Behavior
What happened, and what should happen? Include the exact error.

## Reproduction
Commit, OS, Rust version, API path (local / observed / managed), configuration,
small dataset and commands. Remove credentials and private data.

## Evidence
Relevant logs and tests; distinguish an unknown write outcome from failure.
For performance reports, include resource limits, build profile and repeated runs.

## Scope
Regression from which version, if known? Related issue/PR? Suggested acceptance test?
